name: agent-browser
why: Lets Claude read job ads in your own Chrome profile.

win32.check: if ((Get-Command agent-browser -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { agent-browser --version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } }; if (Test-Path "$HOME/.npm-global/agent-browser.cmd") { & "$HOME/.npm-global/agent-browser.cmd" --version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } }; exit 1
